subject: A K_HARD vs K_HARD_MAX
body:
TASK: A K_HARD vs K_HARD_MAX
STATUS: CANDIDATE (not PASS)
K_HARD = loaded profile Top-K capacity; D wires it with ACTIVE_ID_RANGE.
K_HARD_MAX = C compiled SPEAR slot ceiling; not a profile field; A does not freeze the integer (including not freezing 16).
If profile K_HARD > K_HARD_MAX, fail closed (k_invalid); do not silently clamp.
